kso-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，卡斯托里亚阿里斯托特利斯机场（KSO）的跑道嵌在城镇、农田与植被之间。
kso-sat-1.webp.en: On the satellite image, the runway at Kastoria National Airport Aristotle (KSO) sits between town, farmland and vegetation.

kso-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 浅色墙面上，一排金色希腊字母标出机场名称与出发字样，门前摆着白色花盆。
kso-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Gold Greek letters along the eaves spell out the airport's name above the departures entrance, where white planters line the walkway.

kso-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 夕阳下，带绿色标识的小型客机停在塔台前的机坪上，背后是湖面与连绵山峦。
kso-chatgpt-02.webp.en: In evening light a small white airliner waits on the apron before the control tower, with a lake and mountain ridge behind.

kso-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 白色跑道上，一架白底红蓝条纹的双发涡桨客机滑行经过写有12-30的红色跑道牌。
kso-chatgpt-03.webp.en: A white twin-turboprop airliner with red and blue stripes taxis past a red sign marked 12-30, hills rising beyond the runway.

kso-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 傍晚的航站楼前空无一人，屋檐下的招牌被落日染成暖橙色，地面落着长长的影子。
kso-chatgpt-04.webp.en: At dusk the terminal front stands empty, its signage glowing warm orange in the last sun while long shadows stretch across the paving.

kso-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 航站楼廊桥前停着几架涂装各异的客机，其中一架蓝白机身标有AEGEAN字样。
kso-chatgpt-05.webp.en: Several airliners in different liveries are parked at the terminal's jet bridges, one of them a blue and white AEGEAN jet.
